findings.affected_requirement: Story 11.5 AC-3; spec FR-015, FR-018, FR-019; plan Target Platform and Release E2E/Docker Boundary; user-approved external PostgreSQL non-ownership topology
findings.evidence: The quickstart starts the app with --network container:<provider> and --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway, but Docker container network mode does not support --add-host, so the normative command is not executable. The current harness omits app-side --add-host and adds it only to the provider container, leaving the plan's Linux-host fallback unproven while the plan claims Windows/Linux hosts. The release contract also retains the contradictory sentence that the provider network attachment gives the app access to a PostgreSQL container, immediately before declaring that external PostgreSQL is not attached to that network. Windows Docker Desktop can use its built-in host.docker.internal route, but the artifacts do not define one executable native-Linux fallback compatible with container-network mode, external-server non-ownership, and loopback-only host exposure.
findings.correction_outcome: Choose and specify one executable topology. Remove the unsupported app-side --add-host and stale attached-PostgreSQL sentence. For Docker Desktop, explicitly rely on and preflight built-in host.docker.internal. For native Linux, define a tested fallback that does not combine --add-host with container mode and does not attach, reconfigure, stop, or remove the external PostgreSQL container; fail before resource acquisition when the external endpoint cannot be reached under the loopback-only policy. Pin the same command shape in plan, research, quickstart, release contract, harness tests, and regenerated T064/T065 tasks.

Regenerate tasks without expanding scope.

summary: REVISE with two High findings. The user-approved database-level ownership model is secure and bounded, and the Pass 1/Pass 2/Chat/citation/Data Protection/no-migration/no-general-Scan design remains feasible. The plan set is not yet executable or workflow-unambiguous: its normative app command combines Docker container network mode with unsupported --add-host, its release contract contradicts external PostgreSQL non-attachment, it lacks a tested native-Linux route while claiming Windows/Linux support, and it mixes Full transition with expedited metadata plus a duplicate approval gate. These are correctable without changing the Story 11.5 product spec or PRD and without expanding regenerated tasks.
